items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: after John Board started with Joe Kelly, then we really got together on, you know, different arrangements, and suggestions from Johnny Board.

ctx.x: Of all the bands you played with, what was your favorite?

Well, my real favorite band, big band, was the Earl Fatha Hines. And my little band was Lefty Bates band, until I joined Joe Kelly. And after John Board started with Joe Kelly, then we really got together on, you know, different arrangements, and suggestions from Johnny Board. He really brought the band out. He would swing, all together different sound. We sounded like a 16-piece band.
Yeah, I know. He's got a good sound. You liked the more arranged groups, rather than the loose --
